name: The Drowned Court
description: A faction drawn to drowned law and failed vessels. They operate where justice has leaked into something older.
need: Proof that the fountain is remembering names

plan.description: Seal the fountain's lower chamber before the door opens

name: The Luminous Archive
description: Keepers of bright records in a city that rewrites itself. They believe knowledge is a form of resistance.
need: A complete catalog of post-Shattering phenomena

plan.description: Recruit the player as a field observer

name: The Umbral Covenant
description: Operators who move where public memory thins. They trade in absences.
need: Someone to be forgotten in a specific way

plan.description: Test the player's capacity for strategic forgetting

name: Azure Merchants' Guild
description: Ledger-holders who can buy passage through most locked doors. They measure worth in debts and favors.
need: New markets in information and protection

plan.description: Assess the player as potential client or competitor
